I told Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message that Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is 25 November. Ilse posted that date in the channel on 14 October, and nothing in the channel has changed it since. Marcus is a member of #north-team, so this is a message he can already see.

The channel history also shows an extra message from me on 14 October, just after my thread reply to Ilse. It's my summary of that turn, which reads like a note for you rather than for the team. It doesn't contain anything the channel members couldn't see, but it's clutter you may want to delete.
